user.title: Choose a thermometer
user.description: Pick a nearby thermometer running pvvx firmware, or enter its MAC address.

data_description.address: For example A4:C1:38:12:34:56. Shown in the pvvx flasher and in the Bluetooth integration.

confirm.title: Set up {name}
confirm.description: LCD Ticker will send a test smiley `(^_^)` to the thermometer. It appears within a few seconds and stays for about 10 seconds.

data_description.profile: How often screens change. Eco saves the most battery, Responsive updates fastest. You can change this later.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the thermometer. Move it closer to your Bluetooth adapter and make sure the adapter supports active connections, then try again.
error.invalid_address: This is not a valid MAC address.

init.title: Display settings
init.description: Current settings: about {per_hour} updates per hour, {per_hour_present} while someone is present. Each update is one Bluetooth connection and uses some battery. Writes are skipped when the screen would not change, so the real number is usually lower.

data_description.profile: Choosing Eco, Balanced or Responsive sets both speeds. Editing a speed switches to Custom.
data_description.mode: Single screen + built-in: the thermometer alternates your first screen with its own reading at no extra cost. Rotating: LCD Ticker switches between your screens.

data_description.presence_entity: For example a motion sensor or a person. Screens change faster while it is on and for 10 minutes after.

data.active_entity: Only active when this is on

data_description.active_entity: For example a binary sensor that is on while solar panels produce. Counts as active when its state is on, home or above_horizon.

data_description.on_ha_stop: Rotating mode only. Freeze keeps the last screen until Home Assistant is back. Alternate shows each screen alternating with the built-in reading and falls back to the built-in reading if Home Assistant stops.

error.high_update_rate: These settings mean about {new_per_hour} updates per hour, which drains the battery quickly. Submit again to save anyway.
error.quiet_hours_incomplete: Set both a start and an end for quiet hours, or neither.

user.title: Add a screen
user.description: Start from a preset. You pick the entities next.

sources.title: Where the numbers come from
sources.description: The big number shows one decimal up to 199.5 and whole numbers up to 1999. The small number shows whole numbers from -9 to 99. Values outside are capped.

data_description.big_convert: Converts using the sensor's own unit, for example W to kW or EUR/MWh to c/kWh.
data_description.vat_percent: Added to prices converted to c/kWh. The core Nord Pool integration reports prices without VAT.
data_description.small_fixed: A screen number helps you tell screens apart.
data_description.small_entity: Optional. For solar, pick an existing self-consumption % sensor instead of grid export.

look.title: How the screen looks
look.description: The LCD cannot show text, so give each screen something unique: a unit symbol, the % sign, the battery icon, a face or a fixed small number.

data.title: Screen name
data.unit: Symbol next to the big number
data.percent: % sign next to the small number
data.jump_delta: Show immediately when the big number changes by

data_description.face_t1: Scale faces, best to worst: (^_^) · ^_^ · Δ△Δ · -∧- · (-∧-). With higher is better, a value at or above threshold 4 gets the best face. With lower is better, a value at or below threshold 1 does.
data_description.jump_delta: 0 turns this off. Never writes more than once a minute.

error.unit_not_supported: This sensor's unit cannot be converted to the selected unit.
error.unit_unknown: This sensor has no unit yet, so it cannot be converted. Choose no conversion or wait until the sensor reports a value.
error.solar_small_required: Pick either grid export or a self-consumption % sensor.
error.small_entity_required: Pick the entity for the small number.
error.thresholds_order: Thresholds must go from lowest (1) to highest (4).
error.duplicate_markers: Another screen looks exactly like this one on the LCD. Submit again to keep it anyway.
error.seconds_too_short: Use 0 (thermometer speed) or at least 30 seconds.

unreachable.title: {name} is unreachable
unreachable.description: LCD Ticker has not been able to update {name} for a while. Check that the thermometer is in range of your Bluetooth adapter and that its battery is not empty. This message disappears after the next successful update.

show.name: Show values
show.description: Sends a raw frame to a thermometer. Compatible with pvvx_display.show. The next scheduled screen overwrites it unless rotation is off.

device_id.name: Thermometer
device_id.description: A thermometer set up in LCD Ticker.

address.name: BLE address
address.description: MAC address, for thermometers that are not set up. Use either this or the thermometer.

validity.name: Validity (s)
validity.description: How long the thermometer shows this frame. 65535 = permanently (until reboot). Shorter values alternate with the built-in reading.

unit.name: Big number unit
unit.description: Symbol next to the big number.

percent.name: % sign
percent.description: Show % next to the small number.

happy.name: Happy face
happy.description: Combine happy, sad and bracket into a face.

sad.name: Sad face
sad.description: Combine happy, sad and bracket into a face.
